newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jospin, Kohl to meet in late August - Jospin office.
newsitem.headline: Jospin, Kohl to meet in late August - Jospin office.

text.p: French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin and German Chancellor Helmut Kohl will meet in late August, the French prime minister's office said on Wednesday.
Neither the date nor the location of the meeting was immediately available.
Jospin will be meeting Kohl at a time of deep differences between Paris and Bonn over European economic and monetary union.

Such a meeting to consolidate Franco-German ties since the Socialist-led government's election in June has been long awaited by financial markets as a sign of Jospin's willingness to press ahead with a single European currency.

Jospin, however, was unable to go to Germany for a meeting with Kohl until he had dealt with France's own domestic budget woes following an audit of public finances due on Monday which is expected to show an overshoot in the state deficit.

Bonn has been pressing for strict conformity with a Maastricht treaty requirement that state deficits be three percent of gross domestic product while France's new leftist government wants a more flexible reading of the treaty.
